summary: AEON Biopharma filed an 8-K reporting the entry into an underwriting agreement for a firm-commitment public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants with milestone warrants. The combined offering price was $0.3221 per share/unit and $0.3220 per pre-funded warrant unit. The offering closed on July 15, 2026 with net proceeds of ~$12.2 million for working capital and biosimilar testing. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
